ELITE 2026-06-20 (v0.9.0): net-new elite-manual-qa-2026.md. GATE-0 vs already-held (visual-regression TOOLS named Chromatic/Percy/Playwright toHaveScreenshot; accessibility axe+manual at WCAG 2.1 AA; Playwright-Pro flake root-cause catalog; internal P0-P3 taxonomy + output format): four genuinely net-new ELITE layers absorbed as METHODOLOGY. (1) Visual-regression baseline DISCIPLINE - generate/update baselines in the SAME pinned CI/Docker env (not laptops), freeze animations+clock+network before snapshot, MASK dynamic regions instead of loosening the global threshold, per-component thresholds, and baseline-update GOVERNANCE (every update is reviewed code: bug-vs-intended decision, linked to PR). The tools were named; the discipline that makes them trustworthy was not. (2) Accessibility as WCAG CONFORMANCE - pinned to WCAG 2.2 AA (56 criteria incl. the 2.2 additions teams fail: target-size 24px 2.5.8, dragging alternative 2.5.7, accessible auth 3.3.8, focus-not-obscured/appearance 2.4.11/2.4.13, consistent-help, redundant-entry), the axe-core(~29.5% SC automated)+pa11y automated FLOOR / human CEILING split, and the VPAT/ACR-style conformance-report deliverable (Supports/Partially/Does-Not per SC) rather than a defect dump. (3) Deterministic/HERMETIC flake elimination - upstream doctrine over the existing catalog: control all four non-determinism sources (freeze clock, HAR/route network hermeticity, seed data, isolate state); retry-once is a detector not a fix. (4) CLIENT-READY bug-report standard - severity-vs-priority as INDEPENDENT axes, 9 mandatory fields (title/environment/numbered-repro/expected/actual/visual-evidence/severity+priority/supporting-data/reporter-date), one-bug-per-report, repro discipline, and the client deliverable format with a tested/NOT-tested scope section. Sourced from 2026 visual-regression / WCAG-2.2 / Playwright-determinism / bug-reporting standards. Wired into rules.md (4 decision rules + ref) + SKILL.md (References table). CONNECT/host-wiring: Chrome + Playwright browsers + pinned Playwright Docker image for CI-parity baseline generation; Docker-in-CI for baselines/Testcontainers; real screen readers (VoiceOver/NVDA/TalkBack) for the AT conformance pass; axe-core + pa11y in CI for the automated floor. No em-dashes; one net-new registered reference.
